propositions: usage_log.record() is called after the except block in PydanticAIRunner.run(), so when an LLM call raises an exception, no usage row is written and the call is invisible to spend totals
failed LLM calls leave no trace in the usage log file, making spend summaries under-report actual consumption and preventing per-step cost attribution for expensive failure cases

a failed call must write a usage row with identifying fields (op, step, model_class, model, provider) and token counters, explicitly marked with outcome=failed to distinguish burned budget from delivered work

the fix adds record_failure() in the except block before interpret_failure() re-raises, resolving step/model_class from ContextVar and deriving counters from failure_usage(), then calls record(..., outcome=OUTCOME_FAILED)
